info.name: me2-server
info.description:
API for the Me app.

Setup: set the `baseUrl` collection variable (default http://localhost:4000), then run **Auth → Sign up** (or **Log in**). The returned token is saved automatically and sent as a Bearer token on every other request; ids from create/list requests are saved too, so the {{routineId}}-style URLs work as you go.

Set `timezone` to your IANA zone — it is sent as the X-Timezone header so "today" is computed correctly.

exec: // Send the caller's timezone so "today" is decided in it, not the server's (UTC).
// {{today}} (YYYY-MM-DD in that timezone) for request bodies.

request.description: Creates an account and saves the returned token into the {{token}} variable.
Saves the returned token into the {{token}} variable.
Tokens are stateless, so this just returns {}; signing out means the app discards its token. (This request deliberately leaves {{token}} alone so the rest of the collection keeps working.)
Signed in. A wrong currentPassword is a 400 (not 401). Your token keeps working. Note: this changes the password of the account you are signed in as.

Always returns {} (whether or not the email is registered) and emails a 6-digit code. Locally, with no email provider configured, the code is printed in the server console. A code is not re-sent within 60 seconds.
Replace otp with the emailed code (a string). Saves the returned resetToken into {{resetToken}}. 5 attempts per code, 10 minute expiry.
Spends {{resetToken}} (single use, valid 15 minutes after verifying) and signs out every existing session — log in again afterwards.
